text.overview: With Johnston’s facilities undamaged during the Capellans’ ejection from New Syrtis, the company expanded production as much as possible to prop up the faltering Davion military. Their new Axman was just a prototype in 3146, and only a lack of components stopped the Capellans from putting it into full production. Sharing a number of components with the Caesar -5D and Hatchetman -7D, the new Axman -5N is a terror at any range. The Tiburon Khanate-supplied HAG 20 and ER PPC allow it to deal damage as it closes, while triple ER medium lasers deal significant short-range damage. These weapons provide a number of ways to activate the ’Mech’s triple-strength myomers, allowing the -5N to close quicker and deal unholy amounts of damage in close combat.
text.notableUnits: Si-ben-bing Sewarion Smirnow: A recent graduate from the Victoria Academy of Arms and Technology on Gunthar, Smirnow was thrust into the limelight during the Davion re-conquest of New Syrtis. After his Vindicator was damaged early in the battle, he acquired one of the Axman -5N prototypes to carry on the fight, and scythed his way through nearly two lances of the Illician Lancers’ Fifty-Ninth Striker Regiment as they tried to storm the Saso spaceport.:br::br::tab:Eventually forced to retreat, Smirnow and a few stragglers carried on guerrilla attacks against the Davions for another two months before retreating off-world in late February 3148. He would later put the ’Mech to good use against the Republic during the Operation Bàoyìng attacks the following year on Terra Firma, helping to finish off the second battalion of the Thirteenth Principes.

text.overview: The new Banshee is the latest stage of evolution that began with the BNC-3S. The -12S builds upon the endo-steel chassis of prior models, upgrading it with a home-built Clan-grade engine and lasers. The weight savings enabled Defiance’s engineers to follow the weaponry layout of the -3S. Armor levels match the toughest Banshees, creating a very strong and fast assault ’Mech, albeit one with a challenging heat curve. Alpha-striking will shut the ’Mech down, so MechWarriors are advised to use either the main or secondary weapons, but not both at once.
text.notableUnits: Hauptmann Christopher Cain: Cain was a green leutnant fresh from the academy when he was assigned to the newly reformed Eighth Lyran Guards. The Eighth specialized in Republic of the Sphere tactics and served as an OpFor for training other Lyran units. Thus, they were woefully unprepared for the Jade Falcon desant on Porrima in 3134. Barely a quarter of the regiment escaped the slaughter. His father and son were killed when Galaxy Commander Aleksandr Hazen razed a district of Allison City after an unsuccessful assassination attempt, though the Falcons eventually decided not to hold the world.:br::br::tab:Cain is now a battle-hardened veteran. He was promoted while the unit slowly rebuilt. The Eighth refused to leave Porrima during the tenure of Archon Brewer. They later absorbed the remnants of the Sixth Guards following the battle of Tharkad. The Eighth is now based on Veckholm where Cain commands a company—Cain’s Cavaliers. His deep-seated hatred for the Falcons is surpassed only by his sense of duty to his MechWarriors, all of whom are survivors of battles against the Clans.

text.overview: Thanks to a reciprocal licensing agreement with Robinson Standard BattleWorks, Kong Interstellar received the plans to the BLK-NT series, allowing them to produce the ’Mech for the Republic. Not content to just manufacture the Robinson version, they applied the technology to their own classic Black Knight, resulting in the -18-KNT. With the sundering of the Republic, Kong found themselves in need of a new supply of Clan weaponry and formed a trade agreement with our Clan to supply their needs. Using an endocomposite frame and light engine, the -18-KNT updates the -6-KNT with Clan weaponry and heatsinks while adding a targeting computer.
text.notableUnits: Lieutenant JG Duarte Veiga: Known as “Dutty” to friends and foes alike, Veiga is as passionate about fine food as he is his posting in the Third Marik Protectors, the Imperators. Descended from the Tenth and Eighteenth Marik Militia regiments, the Third offer their services to protect independent worlds of the Free Worlds League, only accepting defensive contacts and charging enough to cover their expenses. Covering worlds sandwiched between the League and the Duchy of Andurien, the Imperators have been very busy fending off pirates and raids from numerous neighboring powers over the last few decades.:br::br::tab:With a palate a noble would be jealous of, but lacking one’s deep pockets, Veiga is able to indulge his foodie passion on the back of each successful defense thanks to grateful locals. He claims to maintain his slim physique from the workout he receives from frequent ’Mech combat, which drives his Black Knight’s cockpit to sauna-like temperatures despite its advanced cooling system.
